figurative_meaning_en: On the rise or growing progressively
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ব্যবসা বাড়ন্ত, প্রতি মাসে লাভ বাড়ছে।
এই ছেলেটি বাড়ন্ত গড়নের, ভবিষ্যতে অনেক দূর যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: His business is on the rise, with profits increasing every month.
This boy has a promising build; he will go far in the future.
note: Refers to physical or metaphorical growth, often implying potential for future success in Bengali colloquial usage.
